name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Shiki-highlighted code in warm stone and cream themes, with a file title bar and language pill, a copy button that morphs into a check while "Copied" slides out, highlighted and focused lines, and long blocks that collapse under a progressive blur with "Show 22 more lines".
docs: Import CodeBlock from components/eased/code-block/code-block. Grammars load on demand; pass `tokens` from highlight() (components/eased/_primitives/code-core/highlighter) on the server for a first paint that is already coloured. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
